name: Deep Motion X Ornella All Night Long
description: Prepare for an all-night techno journey at the historic Hard Club, located in the iconic Mercado Ferreira Borges.
longDescription:
Deep Motion presents an extended set by Ornella, a DJ known for her contributions to the techno scene. This event marks a collaboration designed to offer a continuous musical narrative, focusing on the deeper, more intricate aspects of electronic music. Ornella's background includes performances at various European clubs, establishing her as a presence within the genre.

Attendees can expect an immersive atmosphere lasting through the night, characteristic of a dedicated techno event. The Hard Club, situated within the historic Mercado Ferreira Borges, provides a distinctive backdrop for this type of performance. The venue's industrial architecture and central location contribute to its established reputation as a key space for nightlife in Porto, attracting an audience primarily interested in electronic music.

Admission to Deep Motion X Ornella All Night Long is ticketed. The Hard Club is located near the São Bento train station and is within walking distance of the Ribeira district. It is also accessible via the São Bento metro station, served by Line D.
